title: Three Major Takeaways from Cavs vs. Hawks
text: Three Major Takeaways from Cavs vs. Hawks Thursday night’s game with the Atlanta Hawks continued an unsettling trend. The Cleveland Cavaliers trailed by double-digits for a fourth consecutive game. And Oct 28, 2026; Cleveland, Ohio, USA; Cleveland Cavaliers guard Donovan Mitchell reacts in the fourth quarter against the Washington Wizards at Rocket Arena. Mandatory Credit: David Richard-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Thursday night’s game with the Atlanta Hawks continued an unsettling trend. The Cleveland Cavaliers trailed by double-digits for a fourth consecutive game. And while they were able to pull wins out of the other three, this one did not quite go the same. Not completely.“Terrible for your cardiovascular system to go through this every night. ” — Daugherty on the Cavs coming from double-digits down to win three straight games by Mitchell.The star has to encourage looks for their teammates, not quite take them. And while it was probably not intentional, it’s still not a good look. Harden only dished out four assists in this game. Considering how much he has the rock, it really isn’t ideal.Mitchell didn’t have any TO’s, but only had two assists. Another high usage guard, he has to make sure he’s finding his bigs. It’s the role of Harden and Mitchell to keep Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen involved. Nobody else can do it for them.And that wasn’t the case tonight, an unfortunate theme of this campaign. On the plus side, both guards were getting some baskets down the stretch of this game. But, there are a lot of things they will have to improve on over the course of the 48. He has scored 26 points 39 minutes over two appearances, but done so many other things.Jarrett Allen said the rookie’s presence had him working harder. Kenny Atkinson did say that when he returns, Thomas is going to get even more playing time. To get so high up in the rotation here so early is invaluable. Tyrese Proctor did look good on the floor, but it wasn’t the same.Because it was a very off-night from Jaylon Tyson, the slack wasn’t fully picked up behind Sam Merrill and his sharp 3PT shooting. Mario Hezonja had some moments, but wasn't out there in crunch time. His energy was missed on both ends of the floor. When they play Milwaukee on Saturday, they’ll happily have him back.The Bucks are next on Saturday on the road. Then the team is back home to face the Thunder on Monday. Zach has been a fan of Cavaliers basketball since the summer of 2003, despite growing up in Bergen County, New Jersey. He’s been making yearly trips to Cleveland to watch the team, while engaging with fans on Across The Cavs since 2019.
